Nina Park: GrantThornton requesting a reproducible "replay kit" for the emergency KMS rotation we ran for CVE-2025-9001. Scope: prod account 123456789012 (us-west-2). They want: clear event -> principal -> key_arn -> timestamp mapping, RBAC diffs for deprov'd service accounts, key-policy snapshots pre/post, approval metadata, and a replay script. Can someone own packaging + short narrative?

Zach Miller: I can pull CloudTrail + KMS control-plane events. Plan: CloudTrail lookup for kms.amazonaws.com events in window 2025-11-29T00:00:00Z -> 2025-12-02T23:59:59Z and a CSV index mapping eventId,userIdentity.arn,eventTime,resources. Ill include exact CLI commands and raw JSON snippets. Example: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-11-29T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-12-02T23:59:59Z --query Events[*].CloudTrailEvent`

Theo Kim: Ill produce the RBAC change export (csv: change_id,actor,target,pre_bindings,post_bindings,ticket). Will scrub personal emails and provide a redaction_map file so auditor can map if needed. Ill also run an impersonation test to generate the AccessDenied event for the deprov role.

Auditor - GrantThornton: We need assurance that the bundle is reproducible. Please include a `replay_check.sh` that re-runs read-only lookups and verifies the sha256. Also need the approval chain for rotation id rot-20251130-55 (who signed & timestamp) and signed attestation. Can you show keystore policy before and after?

Zach Miller: Will add `cloudtrail/events.json`, `cloudtrail/index.csv`, `kms_policies/key-policy-before.json`, `kms_policies/key-policy-after.json`, `scripts/replay_check.sh`, `manifests/sha256.txt`. Ill also enable S3 object-lock on the final tar and include the put-object response headers in the manifest.

Theo Kim: Deprov proof: ran assume-role -> attempted decrypt at 2025-12-01T07:04:12Z, CloudTrail shows AccessDenied for arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/deprov-svc-role. Raw event saved as cloudtrail/errors/af3b9c2a.json.

evidence-bot: snapshot job started (job id: keyproof-1749999991).

Zach Miller: Uploaded replay kit to s3://redwood-evidence/prod/keyproof-1749999991.tar.gz (object-lock enabled). Size 920MB. Manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/prod/keyproof-1749999991/manifest.json (sha256: 7d4c9f...). Included a one-page narrative tying CVE -> risk assessment -> mitigation (deprov + rotation) and a control matrix mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.

Auditor - GrantThornton: Received. Quick clarifying Q: who approved rot-20251130-55 and at what UTC timestamp? Also confirm any redactions applied.

Nina Park: Approval chain attached: INC-10042 approvals: "Theo Kim (SecOps)" 2025-11-30T02:10:05Z, "Nina Park (CISO)" 2025-11-30T02:24:36Z. Redactions: internal IPs and personal emails replaced; ARNs and key IDs are intact. Redaction map included at tickets/redactions_map.md. Ready for remote replay when you are. :thumbsup:
